item.title: Baka wa Shinanakya Naoranai!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: integral
  • 発売日: 2014-08-17
  • スコア: 6.11/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: バカは死ななきゃ治らないっ！
  • 英語名: Baka wa Shinanakya Naoranai!

あらすじ

This is the debut work for doujin circle integral. Kazuhiko was run over by a truck on his first day of school. However, when he arrived in heaven, God told him that it’d be a problem if he was dead, and sent him back to Earth. He didn’t understand what happened, but he went to his classroom and found that he had to repeat the year. His osananajimi Kanade became his senpai, and a Russian serial killer Elena transferred into his class.
